subject: general
question:
Select the option that is related to the first letter-number cluster in the same way as the fourth letter-number cluster is related to the third letter-number cluster and sixth letter-number cluster is related to fifth letter-number cluster.

(NOTE: Operations should be performed on the whole numbers, without breaking down the numbers into its constituent digits. E.g.13 – Operations on 13 such as adding /subtracting /multiplying etc. to 13 can be performed. Breaking down 13 into 1 and 3 and then performing mathematical operations on 1 and 3 is not allowed)

 AD120 : ? :: BK220 : DN720 :: DL170 : FO670
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4b40296173ce889b78fe417c923e76d1c6b78d00dd849f34227bf55d444283b1.png] 

The logic followed here is:

For, BK220 : DN720

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c999330a6f4146bbe067d8425177eec195ef6bdeed72db3b6ad60f0c636e358d.png] 

For, DL170 : FO670

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/5bf131168babdaa9d98cc8aebb144d130c7e856bff7b60d2cc50d39b206b6277.png] 

Now, AD120 : ?

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/766b55dff96dde2f7f7e4574e3c7a3f4ae3a1af90dec026ba9b93e99191db28e.png] 

So, AD120 → CG620

Hence, the correct answer is **Option 2.**
